<mxfile host="Electron" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="第 1 页" id="praP0vK1-jkUsUiE1-PY"> <mxGraphModel dx="2026" dy="1032" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "%%{init: {'flowchart': {'defaultRenderer': 'elk'}}}%%
flowchart TD
 %% Main System Background
 subgraph 主系统 [\"Quant Strategy Research Multi-Agent System\"]
 direction TB
 
 %% Three Core Agents (内部采用横向排列以压缩整体宽度)
 subgraph 因子 [\"Factor Researcher Agent\"]
 direction LR
 QX1[Alpha Factor Discovery]
 QX2[Literature Review]
 QX3[Paper Reproduction]
 end
 
 subgraph 策略 [\"Strategy Engineer Agent\"]
 direction LR
 SQ1[Strategy Coding]
 SQ2[Parameter Tuning]
 SQ3[Multi-Factor Synthesis]
 end
 
 subgraph 测试 [\"Testing Engineer Agent\"]
 direction LR
 CX1[Backtesting Verification]
 CX2[Multi-Market Simulation]
 CX3[Stress Testing]
 end
 
 %% Review Agent
 subgraph 评审 [\"Review Agent (Multi-Agent Debate)\"]
 style PY fill:#ffffff
 style AJ fill:#ffffff
 PY[Multi-Agent Debate]
 AJ[Parameter Adjustment]
 end
 
 %% Risk Control Agent
 subgraph 风控 [\"Risk Control Agent\"]
 FK[Risk Monitoring & Intervention]
 end
 
 subgraph 部署 [\"Live Deployment Agent\"]
 SY[Real-Time Strategy Deployment]
 end
 
 %% Core Connection Lines (完整保留所有连线)
 QX1 & QX2 & QX3 -->|Output| SQ1 & SQ2 & SQ3
 SQ1 & SQ2 & SQ3 -->|Output| CX1 & CX2 & CX3
 CX1 & CX2 & CX3 -->|Output| PY & AJ
 AJ -->|Output| PY
 
 PY -->|Output| FK
 FK -->|Adjust Parameters| QX1
 
 PY -->|Output| SY
 AJ -->|Output| SY
 SY -->|Output| QX1
 FK -->|Adjust Parameters| SQ1
 end",
 "config": null
